related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

dirty_main_checkout.interpretation: the shared main checkout retains its existing mutation coordination gate

outcome.interpretation_limit: The selected-worktree behavior is verified with bounded repository fixtures and the resulting event shape is covered by projection tests. No edit, merge, push, concurrent mutation, or independent agent workflow was executed.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Selected proposal worktree preflight required a repeated checkout path or persistent claim
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Before the implementation, merge and publish preflight inferred the session's selected checkout, while local write, mutate, execute, and verify preflight defaulted a repository-name target to repository scope. The selected non-main worktree therefore was not recognized as the local proposal surface unless the caller supplied a more specific target or scope. The user reported recurring authorization overhead; exact historical denial records for this path were not established.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: user-reported recurring friction; system-recorded recurrence not established
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Resolve a repository-name local preflight through the session's selected checkout, refresh checkout identity and Git state, preserve broad claims as coordination evidence, and keep shared main under its existing gate.
